ThingDef.label: material supplier
ThingDef.description:
Supplies the transporter or refuelable building directly ahead. Manual mode delivers items from its internal container. Continuous mode sends up to three selected item types directly from the network, in order of priority, without storing them in the supplier.

Fuel delivery uses normal refueling rules: delivery starts when the remaining fuel reaches the building's automatic refueling threshold, usually 30% of its target fuel level. With enough stock, it refills to the target level. Fuel item counts are rounded up as in normal refueling.

For transport pods, click Create launch group before selecting the items to load.
